fact: Namibia states in its national report for the 12th Ozone Research Managers Meeting (24-26 April 2023) that it has the equipment and access to satellite imagery and that satellite data are readily available but underutilised for lack of technical capacity.
title: Guidelines for the Content and Format of National Reports for the 12th WMO/UNEP Ozone Research Managers Meeting: Republic of Namibia
publisher: National Ozone Office, Republic of Namibia (Ozone Secretariat, UNEP)
